title: Change an appointment's doctor or room
summary: Reassign the appointment to another doctor or another calendar from its menu.

steps.title: Menu → Appointments
steps.details: The calendar shows appointments by room and doctor.

steps.title: Right-click the appointment
steps.details: The appointment menu opens. If you don't see it, change the day with the arrows or use Find appointment.

steps.title: Change doctor
steps.details: Hover and choose the new doctor. For several appointments at once, use Bulk operations.

steps.title: Change room
steps.details: In the same menu: moves the appointment to another calendar keeping the day and time.
